title: The Vector of New Lagos
author: Dominic Voss
blurb: Sable Lockridge, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
